criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: No frame fully passes the showstopper test at 432 px. 9 about 7.5, 1 about 7 (lower floor evenly lit, no pool, no long cast), 4 the best relief. Frame 2 has no tray and floats over teal-grey fog with a dead lower zone. Frame 8 crate right face crushed black, plywood banding, lifted row one leaning slab, whips flat. Frame 7 raised cells read as a dotted line and their cast as a smear. Frame 5 join is a rectangular plug. Frame 6 pool left of the tower and base into the footer band. Frame 3 reads as a keyboard, carrier touches the dek. Type light on dark everywhere with no plates is a strength.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck; the tray motif changes state across 1, 3, 6, 7, 9; cyan means only a Vista node. Held below 8 by two grades (charcoal reliefs, navy hall), frame 2 outside both with teal-grey fog, 6 and 9 near twins.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to a claim; rejected findings honoured; drawn to illustrate stated; c9 kept at its source's strength. Deduction for TACC facts via HPCwire reprints; 'Frontera is dark' a little looser than 'retired'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where clear; the stake stays general and nothing is actionable; UT Southwestern unplaced.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, the turn to what the machine computed is real, the close lands. Frame 3 restates the cover and 'almost the same speed' is said on 1, 3 and 9.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and measured with good lines; frame 8's last sentence reads as a press release; little regional specificity; repeated quote.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New accent and machine hall, but the structure repeats no. 72: dark interior plus relief mix, a molecular model as the thing computed, a counting relief with raised cells, a count-led opening.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 2, 8, 7 and 5 as staged scenes with their subject in the pool: 2 as a whole steel tray on the dark tile, 8 with a lit plenum and a bounce-filled crate, 7 with cells big enough to read, 5 with a continuous neck.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No tray in frame; fin stacks and DIMM slabs float over teal-grey fog; bottom third dead.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back and up so the tray walls, pan and lip enclose both sinks; seat it on the dark tile in the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Crate shadow face crushed black, plywood banding, one leaning slab, flat whips; reads as a nightstand.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Open a lifted row with a lit plenum edge and whips rising toward the crate; fill the right face to L* 8 to 12; fine grain.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Eight raised cells read as a dotted line; cast reads as a smear.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the eight cells three times higher with lit chamfers and crisp short casts; darken the field.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Join is a rectangular plug; bundles shrink against frame 4.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A continuous hourglass neck; keep the bundles at frame 4's height.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pool left of the tower; rails read as a ladder; base runs into the footer band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Centre the pool under the tower; base above y 900.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Carrier touches the dek; grid reads as a keyboard.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the carrier 40 px and darken it.
